## Why this is a new experiment, not an enlarged four-mask table

The legacy benchmark is a completed $3\times2^4=48$ architecture-by-loss grid.
The newer mask is a **mixed-level** design: fixed MSE, five binary additions,
and one five-level MMD selector. It therefore contains $2^5\times5=160$
conditions per architecture and seed. The last character is categorical; the
study does not estimate seven binary effects.

| Position | Field | Levels | Scientific question |
|---:|---|---|---|
| 1 | MSE | fixed at 1 | common reconstruction anchor |
| 2 | correlation | 0/1 | does scale-free waveform agreement help? |
| 3 | derivative | 0/1 | does local slope matching preserve transitions? |
| 4 | Kors VCG | 0/1 | does spatial-vector consistency help? |
| 5 | energy distance | 0/1 | does distributional matching help? |
| 6 | lead consistency | 0/1 | do electrophysiologic lead identities help? |
| 7 | MMD kernel | 0–4 | which distributional geometry, if any, is useful? |

## Live checkpoint reconciliation

The table is recomputed from the checkpoint catalog on every render. A
registered checkpoint is not automatically a test-set result or a clinical
evaluation.

```{python}
#| label: seven-mask-checkpoint-coverage
coverage = checkpoint_completeness()
display(coverage.style.format({"coverage_pct": "{:.1f}%"}))
fig = px.bar(coverage, x="architecture", y="registered", color="architecture",
             text="registered", range_y=[0, 168],
             title="Seed-42 seven-mask checkpoints registered out of 160")
fig.add_hline(y=160, line_dash="dash", annotation_text="complete grid")
fig.show()
```

At the current snapshot, U-Net is complete, MSVAE is missing five cells, and
ECG-AIM is missing 37. Consequently, a full three-architecture factorial
comparison is not yet estimable. Partial ECG-AIM rows are operational evidence,
not a substitute for the missing cells.

## Provenance gates

Every admissible comparison must match observed leads (I, II, V2), PTB-XL
patient split, 500 Hz/no-normalization preprocessing, seed, source generation,
checkpoint selector, and evaluation version. Mask strings alone are not unique
experimental identities. Historical four-mask results and one-lead results are
kept in separate chapters.

## Claims this chapter permits

- Exact statements about which checkpoints are registered and verified.
- Exact statements about design structure and missing cells.
- No claims about test performance from checkpoint counts.
- No architecture-wide clinical claims until clinical evaluation coverage is
  reconciled separately.
